timeline.body:
When creating a model hosted by Elastic ensure the download task has been created before responding to the PUT

Closes #102948

timeline.author: David Kyle

timeline.body: If `waitForCompletion` is `false` will this now block until the download is complete?

reply.body: actually just tested this, it works fine 👍
